spells.notes: 전두환 appointee (7·13 개각 of 1987) still in office on 1988-02-25, the caretaker part of his tenure. The appointment order was issued on the afternoon of 1987-07-13 (경향신문 1987-07-14 '임명 발령') and the 임명장 was handed over on the morning of 1987-07-14. Start uses 07-14, the 임명장 date that the ministry pages of the same reshuffle print (교육부 서명원 1987-07-14, 총무처 장기오 1987-07-14) and that Wikipedia gives. With the whole 김정렬 cabinet he handed in his resignation after the last 5th-republic 국무회의 on 1988-02-24 (동아일보 1988-02-24), and he was still receiving visitors as 체육부장관 that afternoon (한국경제 1988-02-25 동정). 노태우 accepted the resignations on the morning of 1988-02-25 before giving the new cabinet its 임명장, so this spell ends on 1988-02-25 (end_reason resigned) and the 노태우 spell starts the same day. The split follows the cross-lineage convention for the seven ministers reappointed (재기용) on 1988-02-25 (justice, interior, finance and foreign ext88 files) and the contemporary reading that a retained minister received a new 임명장 rather than being 유임 (동아일보 1988-02-19 p.2). Former 10th-Assembly member (유신정우회, per ko.wikipedia), not a sitting member in 1987-1988 (not in na_members_12_22.csv). No English Wikipedia interlanguage link (https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=langlinks&lllang=en&format=json&redirects=1&titles=%EC%A1%B0%EC%83%81%ED%98%B8%20%281926%EB%85%84%29, accessed 2026-09-26T09:24:34-0400), so name_en is null. Birth date and gender come from ko.wikipedia '조상호 (1926년)' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=39377872 (birth field '1926년 11월 29일', accessed 2026-09-26T09:24:33-0400, snapshot roster/sources/sports/ext88/persons/kowiki_조상호.json, secondary) and Wikidata Q19941130 (P21 male, P569 1926-11-29, accessed 2026-09-26T09:35:56-0400, snapshot roster/sources/sports/ext88/persons/wikidata_persons.json, secondary).

issues.desc: Cross-lineage note for culture. The MCST page (문화체육부 tab) and Wikipedia list 이민섭 as 문화체육부장관 from 1993-02-26, and the press of 1993-02-26/27 called him 문화체육부장관. 문화체육부 only existed from 1993-03-06. The contemporary reports say 체육청소년부 had no minister after 이진삼 left on 1993-02-26 and was run by its 차관 until the merger (매일경제 1993-02-27 '장관없는 部處로 남아', 동아일보 1993-02-27 '장관이 임명되지않은 두 부처'). So 이민섭 is not a 체육청소년부장관 and this file has no spell for him. On 1993-02-26 he was 문화부장관, and his 문화체육부 spell starts 1993-03-06. The culture lineage should record it that way.

Convention for the 1988-02-25 reappointment. 조상호 was one of the seven 5th-republic ministers kept (재기용) in the first 노태우 cabinet (외무 최광수, 내무 이상희, 재무 사공일, 법무 정해창, 체육 조상호, 건설 최동섭, 체신 오명, 동아일보 1988-02-19 p.1 and 한국일보 1988-02-20). The cabinet's blanket resignations were accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 (매일경제 1988-02-25, 중앙일보 1988-02-25, 조선일보 1988-02-26) and the 23 국무위원 of the new list received 임명장 that morning. This file splits him into a 전두환 spell ending 1988-02-25 (end_reason resigned) and a 노태우 spell starting 1988-02-25, as justice.ext88.json (정해창), interior.ext88.json (이상희), finance.ext88.json (사공일) and foreign.ext88.json (최광수) do. An earlier build of this file (2026-09-26 09:56) kept him as one spell, and this build replaces it. ko.wikipedia '대한민국 체육부' shows one row (1987-07-14 to 1988-12-04), and the 1993 count of ten ministers (조선일보 1993-02-25) counts persons, so neither conflicts with the split. reorg_continuation stays false because this is not a reorganization. The assembler may want a flag that joins the pair.

Start-date convention. Several reshuffles were announced one or two days before the 임명장 (7·13 개각 1987 order 07-13 and 임명장 07-14, 3·17 개각 1990 announced 03-17 and 임명장 03-19, 12·19 개각 1991 announced 12-19 and 임명장 12-20). Start uses the 임명장 date throughout, the date the ministry pages print for the same reshuffles (교육부, 총무처, MCST 문화부 tab). ko.wikipedia follows the 임명장 date for 1987 and 1990 but the announcement date for 1991 (이진삼 1991-12-19). The announcement dates are in nominations.nomination_date.

End-date convention. Where no 면직 date was found (김집, 정동성, 박철언), end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor), so neighbouring spells share one day. ko.wikipedia uses the day before the successor (1990-03-18, 1990-12-26, 1991-12-19 or 1991-12-18). 김집 held his 이임식 on 1990-03-17, two days before the successor's 임명장. For the 3·17 개각 most ext88 lineages end the outgoing holder on 1990-03-19 as this file does, but epb.ext88.json ends 조순 on 1990-03-17, the announcement and 이임식 day. The assembler should apply one rule to that reshuffle.

Rename date and 박철언's title. offices_1988.json dates 체육청소년부 from 1990-12-27 (법률 제4268호 on promulgation), 국가기록원 from 1991-02-01 (직제), and the press of 1990-12-27/28 spoke of the new ministry launching on 1991-01-01. 박철언 was appointed on 1990-12-27 and most papers titled him 체육청소년부장관, but 매일경제 wrote '청소년체육부(前체육부)장관' and some reports still said 체육부장관. The file follows the statute and gives him 체육청소년부 from 1990-12-27. 정동성 (체육부) ends 1990-12-27, one day into the 체육청소년부 period, because the rename and the reshuffle fell on the same day.

Vacancy 1993-02-27..1993-03-05. 이진삼 left by 의원면직 on 1993-02-26 and no minister was appointed before the merger. The acting record for 차관 이해봉 is inferred. 총무처 ruled that the 차관 acts, and 이해봉 is the 차관 named on 1993-02-06. No 체육청소년부 차관 appears in the 1993-03-04 차관급 인사 list (동아일보 1993-03-04 p.1, News Library article 1993030400209201003, snapshot roster/sources/sports/ext88/articles/nl_1993030400209201003.json). Wikipedia ends his 차관 term on 1993-02-25, which conflicts with the 차관체제 reports. No source naming the acting head during the vacancy was found.

BigKinds transcription errors. The BigKinds text of 중앙일보 1988-02-19 (01100901.19880219004312001) lists '서상호 체육' among the reappointed ministers, and 중앙일보 1988-03-10 (01100901.19880310010508001) has '서상호 체육부장관'.
